record.paper_title: Some open problems on excluding a uniform matroid
record.context_brief: Structure with a spanning bicircular-clique restriction
record.original_question: Can one give a qualitative structure theorem for matroids with no U_{a,b}-minor that have a spanning B(K_n)-restriction, where B(K_n) is the bicircular matroid of the complete graph K_n?

evidence.quote: The bicircular matroid of G, denoted B(G), is defined as B+(G) \ V.
Give a qualitative structure theorem for the matroids with no Ua,b-minor that have a spanning B(Kn)-restriction.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
For a graph G, let B(G) denote the bicircular matroid of G: the matroid on the edge set E(G) whose independent sets are exactly the edge sets F ⊆ E(G) such that every connected component of the subgraph (V(G), F) contains at most one cycle. For integers 0 ≤ a ≤ b, let U_{a,b} denote the uniform matroid of rank a on b elements. A matroid N is a restriction of a matroid M if N = M|X for some subset X of the ground set of M; such a restriction is spanning if the rank of N equals the rank of M. A matroid M has an N-minor if N can be obtained from M by a sequence of deletions and contractions.

Problem. Fix integers a, b with 0 ≤ a ≤ b, and let K_n be the complete graph on n vertices. Provide a qualitative structure theorem describing all matroids M that satisfy both of the following:
(i) M has no U_{a,b}-minor;
(ii) M has a spanning restriction isomorphic to B(K_n) for some n.

That is, characterize the class of such matroids in a way that exposes their global structure (e.g., via a description in terms of natural matroid operations applied to a bounded list of "basic" building blocks).
artifact.status_search_result: Searches on matroid structure theory and bicircular matroids return work on excluded minors for the class of bicircular matroids and related topics, but no source providing a qualitative structure theorem for matroids with no U_{a,b}-minor having a spanning B(K_n)-restriction. The Matroid Union blog and recent arXiv work emphasize that such structure theorems beyond the graphic/frame setting are still being developed, so the problem appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: The limits of structure theory? | The Matroid Union
status_evidence.snippet: Discussion of how far matroid structure theory has been pushed beyond graphic and frame matroid settings.
status_evidence.claim: Qualitative structure theorems beyond frame matroid classes remain a developing area.

status_evidence.title: There are Only a Finite Number of Excluded Minors for the class of bicircular matroids
status_evidence.snippet: Finiteness of excluded minors for bicircular matroids is established, but this addresses recognition, not structure under U_{a,b}-exclusion.
status_evidence.claim: Existing results on bicircular matroids do not provide the requested structure theorem.
